# Pending invitation API endpoint
{: .no_toc}

An invitation by email to someone without an account yet, for a role on a group, project or personal attribute; it takes effect when they sign up.

## Table of contents
{: .no_toc .text-delta }

1. TOC
{:toc}

## Endpoints

- **Private portal:** `https://www.brainstem.org/api/private/users/pendinginvitation/` (needs a token; one record: append `<id>/`)
- **Public portal:** not available
- **Response keys:** `pending_invitation` (detail, create, update), `pending_invitations` (list)
- **Permissions:** see the [permissions page](/datamodel/permissions/)
- **Uniqueness:** `token` unique across BrainSTEM

## Fields

**[required]** fields must be sent on create; **[read-only]** fields are returned but cannot be set. A *nestable* relation can be traversed in filters (`filter{field.other}`) and sideloaded with `include[]=field.*`; other relations can only be compared with ids (`filter{field}=<id>`). See the [query syntax](/api/#query-parameters).

| Field | Description |
|:------|:------------|
| `id` | UUID string **[read-only]** |
| `email` | string **[required]**; max 254 characters. Email address of the invitee (normalized to lowercase) |
| `resource_type` | computed **[read-only]** |
| `invited_to` | computed **[read-only]** |
| `can_change` | boolean **[read-only]** |
| `manage` | boolean **[read-only]** |
| `own` | boolean **[read-only]** |
| `expires_at` | datetime **[read-only]** |
| `is_expired` | computed **[read-only]** |
| `is_accepted` | boolean **[read-only]** |
| `user` | [`user`](/api/users/user/) id **[read-only]** |

## List
- **Allowed portals:** private
- **Request method:** GET
- **URL:** `https://www.brainstem.org/api/private/users/pendinginvitation/`
- **Responses:** `200` OK; `401` Not authenticated; `403` Not allowed

### Use example (Python API tool)
{: .no_toc}

```python
resp = client.load('pendinginvitation', load_all=True)
records = resp['pending_invitations']
```

### Use example (MATLAB API tool)
{: .no_toc}

```matlab
resp = client.load('pendinginvitation', 'load_all', true);
records = resp.pending_invitations;
```

### Response example
{: .no_toc}

```json
{
    "pending_invitations": [
        {
            "id": "<id>",
            "email": "",
            "resource_type": null,
            "invited_to": null,
            "can_change": true,
            "manage": true,
            "own": true,
            "expires_at": "2024-03-22T10:30:00Z",
            "is_expired": null,
            "is_accepted": true,
            "user": "<user-id>"
        }
    ],
    "meta": {
        "page": 1,
        "per_page": 100,
        "total_results": 1,
        "total_pages": 1
    }
}
```

## Add
- **Allowed portals:** private
- **Request method:** POST
- **URL:** `https://www.brainstem.org/api/private/users/pendinginvitation/`
- **Data:** JSON object with at least the required fields
- **Responses:** `201` Created; `400` Bad request (validation errors per field); `403` Not allowed

### Use example (Python API tool)
{: .no_toc}

```python
resp = client.save('pendinginvitation', data={"email": "<email>"})
record = resp.json()['pending_invitation']
```

### Use example (MATLAB API tool)
{: .no_toc}

```matlab
created = client.save(struct('email', '<email>'), 'pendinginvitation');
record = created.pending_invitation;
```

## Detail
- **Allowed portals:** private
- **Request method:** GET
- **URL:** `https://www.brainstem.org/api/private/users/pendinginvitation/<id>/`
- **Responses:** `200` OK; `403` Not allowed; `404` Not found

### Use example (Python API tool)
{: .no_toc}

```python
resp = client.load('pendinginvitation', id='<id>')
record = resp.json()['pending_invitation']
```

### Use example (MATLAB API tool)
{: .no_toc}

```matlab
out = client.load('pendinginvitation', 'id', '<id>');
record = out.pending_invitation;
```

### Response example
{: .no_toc}

```json
{
    "pending_invitation": {
        "id": "<id>",
        "email": "",
        "resource_type": null,
        "invited_to": null,
        "can_change": true,
        "manage": true,
        "own": true,
        "expires_at": "2024-03-22T10:30:00Z",
        "is_expired": null,
        "is_accepted": true,
        "user": "<user-id>"
    }
}
```

## Change
- **Allowed portals:** private
- **Request method:** PATCH
- **URL:** `https://www.brainstem.org/api/private/users/pendinginvitation/<id>/`
- **Data:** JSON object with the fields to change. Lists (`projects`, `tags`, ...) and JSON payloads (`details`, coordinates) are replaced as a whole: read the record first and send the full list or object.
- **Responses:** `200` OK; `400` Bad request; `403` Not allowed; `404` Not found

### Use example (Python API tool)
{: .no_toc}

```python
resp = client.save('pendinginvitation', id='<id>', data={"email": "new value"})
```

### Use example (MATLAB API tool)
{: .no_toc}

```matlab
client.save(struct('id', '<id>', 'email', 'new value'), 'pendinginvitation', 'method', 'patch');
```

## Delete
- **Allowed portals:** private
- **Request method:** DELETE
- **URL:** `https://www.brainstem.org/api/private/users/pendinginvitation/<id>/`
- **Responses:** `204` Deleted; `400` Still referenced by other records; `403` Not allowed; `404` Not found

### Use example (Python API tool)
{: .no_toc}

```python
resp = client.delete('pendinginvitation', id='<id>')
```

### Use example (MATLAB API tool)
{: .no_toc}

```matlab
client.delete('<id>', 'pendinginvitation');
```
